title: The sharp singularity exponent of biased symmetric sign matrices
exact_target: For each fixed $p\in (0,1)$ excluding 1/2, let $A_n$ be symmetric with independent signs on and above the diagonal, each +1 with probability p. Is $lim_{n\to \infty }$ P(det $A_n=0)^{1/n}=p^2+(1-p)^2$?
